venue.name: Shoppes at Victoria
venue.address: Victoria Tower, Panay Ave, Diliman, Quezon City, 1103 Metro Manila

items.information: Get your cubes ready and test your speed! Join us for a full day of official 3x3x3 speedcubing action recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA) and the Philippine Cubers Association (PCA)! 🏆 FEATURED EVENTS: 3x3x3 Cube (Main Event) (Dual Rounds) 3x3x3 One-Handed (Dual Rounds) 3x3x3 Blindfolded 3x3x3 Multi-Blind 💳 Registration Fee: Regular Registration: ₱500 (covers all events) On-the-Spot Registration: ₱600 (subject to slot availability on competition day) 🗓 Registration Schedule:Registration Opens: September 21, 2026 Slots are filled on a first-paid, first-served basis. Secure your spot early! 📲 Payment Details: Please refer to the Extra Registration Requirements on this WCA competition page for complete payment instructions and proof of payment submission instructions before registering. See you all at the competition floor! 🔥

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2NzU0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--174324fbe7e050c138499d5d6e44f10821d3e17c/Untitled%20-%20August%2013,%202026%20at%2013.08.57.png) Martinsville Minis: Big Cubes 2026 Please Note: This competition does NOT include 3x3x3. EVENTS: 4x4 - 3 Rounds 5x5 - 3 Rounds 6x6 - 3 Rounds 7x7 - 3 Rounds This competition is being supported by Midwest Cubing Association. Central Indiana Speedcubing Club is helping with setup and tear down. The venue allows food & non alcoholic drinks to be brought in. It is a non smoking venue. As always, be courteous and clean up any spills & trash. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg3OTQwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9796bb9c73a631a68e5e66bba8548ab202d3e9a4/Untitled%20-%20May%2027,%202026%20at%2019.19.02.png)
